Shipments that contain critical foodstuff, medicine and perishable goods, we will do our utmost to ensure special attention is given.
We accept bookings to /From **Saudi Arabia (Jeddah & King Abdullah port), Jordan, Oman (Salalah, Sohar), UAE (Khor Fakkan – only imports, and Jebel Ali (via landbridge), Lebanon, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain and Israel.** | #### Transshipments via Jeddah Saudi import and export cargo - Cargo Port of Discharge or Place of Delivery in Saudi Arabia will continue to move through Jeddah.
